final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias reference: IREF flows into ibias, sunk by diode-connected nfet
MB   ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=2 L=2
* tail current source
MT   tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=4 L=2
* NMOS input pair (vinp non-inverting -> output via M2 side)
M1   d1    vinn  tail vss nfet W=10 L=0.5
M2   x     vinp  tail vss nfet W=10 L=0.5
* PMOS mirror load (diode on M1 side)
M3   d1    d1    vdd  vdd pfet W=2 L=1
M4   x     d1    vdd  vdd pfet W=2 L=1
* second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS current sink
M6   vout  x     vdd  vdd pfet W=12 L=1
M7   vout  ibias vss  vss nfet W=12 L=2
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz   x     cz    30000
Cc   cz    vout  2.5e-12
.ends dut
